title: Move €1,200 a week from LinkedIn to Google Search
contextLine: Paid · Due today, 14:00 · 2 min to read
cardContext: A lead costs €200 on LinkedIn and €80 on Search. The weekly budget stays at €4,000.
doneNote: Approved. The Paid agent starts now.
context: In the last 14 days LinkedIn brought 24 leads and Google Search brought 40, for less money. Search leads also take a sales call more often. The weekly budget is €4,000: €2,400 on LinkedIn and €1,600 on Search.

opportunity.label: Opportunity · the dream output
opportunity.headline: 14 sales calls a week by week 4
opportunity.condition: If a Search lead keeps costing €80.
opportunity.summary: With the shift, sales calls a week rise from 10 now to 14 in week 4. With no change they stay at 10.

risk.label: Risk · the worst case
risk.headline: 9 calls a week for two weeks
risk.condition: If a Search lead rises to €130. Then the shift is undone.
risk.summary: In the worst case sales calls a week drop from 10 to 9 in weeks 1 and 2, then return to 10 in week 3 when the shift is undone.

suggestion: Approve the shift for 3 weeks. Search gets €2,800 a week and LinkedIn keeps €1,200 for people who already know you.
guardrail: Guardrail: if a Search lead costs more than €110 for 5 days in a row, the Paid agent moves the money back and tells you. The most this can cost is about 2 sales calls.

nextSteps.step: Move €1,200 a week to the two Search campaigns
Cut LinkedIn down to the retargeting audience
Write 3 new Search ads for the extra budget
Check with sales that the new leads are good
Report the result against the dream output

ifNoAnswer: If you do not answer by 14:00, nothing changes.
